record.paper_title: Results and open problems in matchings in regular graphs
record.original_question: Let Psi_{2n} be Edmonds's perfect-matching polytope inside the symmetric doubly stochastic 2n by 2n zero-diagonal matrices, and let haf_k(B) be the k-haffnian of B. For k = 2,...,n, determine mu_{k,n} = min_{B in Psi_{2n}} haf_k(B), or at least give good lower bounds for this minimum.

evidence.quote: Our problem is to find or give a good lower bound for min B∈Ψ2n hafk(B) = µk,n for k = 2, . . . , n.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\ge 2$ be an integer and let $\Psi_{2n}$ denote Edmonds's perfect-matching polytope realized inside the set of symmetric $2n\times 2n$ doubly stochastic matrices with zero diagonal; equivalently, $\Psi_{2n}$ is the convex hull, inside the space of symmetric $2n\times 2n$ real matrices with zero diagonal, of the matrices $\tfrac12(P+P^{T})$ where $P$ ranges over the $2n\times 2n$ permutation matrices corresponding to fixed-point-free involutions (so the extreme points of $\Psi_{2n}$ are precisely the symmetric $0/1$ adjacency matrices of perfect matchings on $\{1,\dots,2n\}$).

For an integer $k\ge 1$ and a symmetric $2n\times 2n$ matrix $B=(b_{ij})$ with zero diagonal, define the $k$-haffnian of $B$ by
$$\mathrm{haf}_k(B)\;=\;\frac{1}{(2n)!}\sum_{\sigma\in S_{2n}}\;\prod_{j=1}^{n}\,b_{\sigma(2j-1)\,\sigma(2j)}^{\,k},$$
so that for $k=1$ this reduces (up to the standard normalization) to the ordinary hafnian counting perfect matchings.

For each $k\in\{2,3,\dots,n\}$, determine, or give a non-trivial lower bound for,
$$\mu_{k,n}\;=\;\min_{B\in\Psi_{2n}}\mathrm{haf}_k(B).$$
artifact.status_search_result: Web search did not surface specific results determining or bounding the quantity $\mu_{k,n}=\min_{B\in\Psi_{2n}}\mathrm{haf}_k(B)$ for $k\ge 2$. Related literature on hafnians, the permanent-hafnian connection, and Edmonds's perfect-matching polytope is available, but no source establishing a definitive value or sharp lower bound for $\mu_{k,n}$ was found. Status is therefore reported as unknown.

status_evidence.title: Hafnian - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: The hafnian of a symmetric matrix counts the number of perfect matchings of a weighted graph; it is a generalization of the permanent.
status_evidence.claim: Background definition of the hafnian; no specific result on min over the perfect-matching polytope of k-haffnians is given.

status_evidence.title: Approximating permanents and hafnians
status_evidence.snippet: Studies approximation algorithms and bounds for permanents and hafnians of nonnegative matrices.
status_evidence.claim: Related work on bounds for hafnians, but does not address $\mu_{k,n}$ over Edmonds's perfect-matching polytope.
